question.en: Why did Harrison sell his house so quickly?
question.zh: 哈里森为什么这么快就卖掉房子？

sentences.en: Why did Harrison sell his house so quickly?
sentences.zh: 哈里森为什么这么快就卖掉房子？

sentences.en: My old friend, Harrison, had lived in the Mediterranean for many years before he returned to England.
sentences.zh: 我的老朋友哈里森回到英国以前，在地中海地区住了很多年。

sentences.en: He had often dreamed of retiring in England and had planned to settle down in the country.
sentences.zh: 他常梦想在英国退休，并打算在乡间定居。

sentences.en: He had no sooner returned than he bought a house and went to live there.
sentences.zh: 他一回来就买了一幢房子住了进去。

chunks.x: than he bought a house and went to live there

sentences.en: Almost immediately he began to complain about the weather,
sentences.zh: 几乎立刻他就开始抱怨天气，

sentences.en: for even though it was still summer,
sentences.zh: 因为即使那时还是夏天，

chunks.x: for even though it was still summer

sentences.en: it rained continually and it was often bitterly cold.
sentences.zh: 天却下个不停，而且常常冷得厉害。

sentences.en: After so many years of sunshine, Harrison got a shock.
sentences.zh: 在阳光充足的地方住了那么多年，哈里森大吃一惊。

chunks.x: After so many years of sunshine

sentences.en: He acted as if he had never lived in England before.
sentences.zh: 他的举动就好像他从未在英国住过一样。

chunks.x: as if he had never lived in England before

sentences.en: In the end, it was more than he could bear.
He had hardly had time to settle down when he sold the house and left the country.
sentences.zh: 他还没来得及安顿下来就卖掉房子，离开了这个国家。

sentences.en: The dream he had had for so many years ended there.
sentences.zh: 他多年的梦想就此结束。

chunks.x: he had had for so many years

sentences.en: Harrison had thought of everything except the weather.
sentences.zh: 哈里森什么都想到了，就是没想到天气。
